title: SRE: dashboards + alerts for Optimize Guardrails gating health and KPIs
creator: Sean Gallagher
description:
Problem
Optimize Guardrails introduces an async gating workflow (eval runner jobs + policy evaluation) that becomes a hard dependency for applying config changes. We need first-class observability for:
1) Gating health (queue/backlog, latency, error rate) so we can page on issues before customers see timeouts/blocked applies.
2) Product KPIs (pass/fail distribution, failure reasons, override usage, safe-degrade blocks) so we can tune thresholds and rollout stages.

Scope
- Add dashboards + alert rules for guardrails gating.
- Cover both service health (eval runner + gating decision path) and top-level product signals.
- Ensure metrics/labels are PII-safe and do not introduce unbounded cardinality.

Non-goals
- Per-tenant deep dive dashboards as a default (we’ll rely on log/audit event lookup + targeted ad-hoc queries). 
- Building new metrics beyond what ENG-3918 emits, except where small additions are required to make alerting actionable.

Primary users
- SRE on-call (paging + triage)
- Platform Control Plane on-call (queue/worker issues)
- Optimize/PM during pilot rollout (override + failure reason monitoring)

Dashboards to create
A) "Optimize Guardrails / Gating Health" (ops-facing)
Recommended panels (staging + prod, filterable by region/env):
- Eval runner queue depth (jobs queued, jobs running) + oldest job age
- Worker capacity: active workers / max concurrency, worker restarts
- Job lifecycle latency: end-to-end p50/p95/p99 (enqueue -> result persisted)
- Breakdown: eval execution time vs queue wait time
- Gating decision latency (Optimize apply request -> decision available)
- Error rate by category: runner errors (5xx), harness errors, artifact persistence errors, policy evaluation errors
- Timeout rate (runner timeouts + apply-time gating timeouts)
- Cache effectiveness: % cache hit for eval results (requires ENG-3916 metrics)
- No-data / telemetry freshness (last-seen timestamp for key series)

B) "Optimize Guardrails / Product KPIs" (PM + rollout-facing)
Recommended panels:
- Gating outcomes over time: pass / fail / timeout / error
- Failure reasons (top N): metric regression, min sample size not met, CI rule violated, suite missing, policy misconfig, etc.
- Override usage: count + rate; by tenant tier (internal/pilot/enterprise) and by optimization type
- Safe-degrade blocks: applies blocked due to runner unavailable (ties to safe-degrade policy)
- Correlation hooks: Optimize rollback events after apply (if available) + customer quality signals (support escalations tag "guardrails")

Metric/label guidance (cardinality)
- Must support env + region + optimization_type + outcome. 
- Avoid tenant_id, route_id, model_id as default labels in metrics. Use them only in logs/audit events and attach via exemplars where supported.
- Failure reason should be a bounded enum (no free-form strings).
- Audit logs remain the source of truth for customer-level investigations; dashboards are for fleet-level signals.

Alerting
Paging (PagerDuty) - gating health
- Eval runner backlog critical: queue_depth > 500 for 10m OR oldest_job_age_seconds > 900 for 10m (prod)
- Eval job latency critical: p95 end-to-end > 12m for 15m (prod)
- Eval runner error rate critical: (errors / total) > 5% for 10m (prod)
- Gating timeout rate critical: timeouts > 2% for 10m (prod)
- Telemetry missing: key series absent for 15m (prod) (to catch pipeline breaks)

Ticket (Slack) - early warning / pilot quality
- Override rate warning: override_rate > 1% over 1h (pilot cohort)
- Fail rate spike: fail_rate increases by >2x baseline over 2h (pilot cohort)

Notes
- Thresholds above are initial defaults. We will tune after pilot data (see eng-sre alert tuning thread).
- For multi-region: prefer alerting on global + per-region, but page only on global unless impact is isolated and action differs.

Acceptance criteria
- Grafana dashboard(s) created and discoverable under the Optimize/Guardrails folder; includes links to runbook + relevant logs.
- Alert rules created and routed:
  - PD for critical availability/latency/error conditions.
  - Slack channel for warning-level product KPI anomalies.
- Alerts validated via staging load test or synthetic canary (verify firing + clear).
- Documented “first 15 minutes” triage steps in the Guardrails gating runbook (what graphs to check, likely causes, who owns).

References / linked work
- Related tickets: ENG-3914 (eval runner), ENG-3916 (eval result caching), ENG-3918 (audit/telemetry)
- GitHub: observability-pack PR #441 (dashboards + alert rules)
- Confluence: Optimize Guardrails dashboards/alerts spec (eng-platform) and runbook (SRE)

Open questions
- Whether to page on "gating blocked due to runner down" separately from runner availability (depends on tier policy + safe-degrade behavior).
- Do we need an explicit SLO for gating decision latency pre-GA? Proposed: 99% decisions < 15m over 7d, excluding customer-supplied prompt set runs that exceed suite size limits.
activity: 2025-01-16 (Rafael Mendes): Drafted initial dashboard layout and alert thresholds based on staging behavior. Keeping labels bounded; no tenant_id/model_id in metrics. Will rely on audit logs for drill-down.

2025-01-20 (Sean Gallagher): +1. Please add a panel that separates queue wait vs eval execution time; last incident was a worker concurrency regression that looked like “slow evals” but was actually queueing.
2025-01-23 (Logan Wright): Telemetry note: failure_reason must be a bounded enum; do not ship raw exception strings as labels. OK to emit exception class into logs with sampling.

2025-01-27 (Rafael Mendes): Implemented dashboards + alerts in observability-pack PR #441. Added “telemetry freshness” panel and no-data alert for runner metrics. Added separate alert for oldest_job_age_seconds to catch low-throughput stalls even when queue depth is small.

2025-02-03 (Miles Thornton): Ran staging validation with synthetic job flood. Alerts fired as expected; adjusted p95 latency threshold to 12m (was 8m) to reduce noisy paging during cold-start scaling. Added runbook links directly in the Grafana dashboard.
2025-02-06 (Rafael Mendes): PR #441 merged. Alerts enabled in prod but warning-level Slack alerts limited to pilot cohort filters. Marking Done; will revisit thresholds in ENG-3928 retro.
